mcqs.question: The indoor boxing hall associated with Andhra Pradesh's first international-standard boxing ring at Tirupati received support from which organisation?
mcqs.explanation: Junior Chamber International (JCI) supported the indoor boxing hall. SAI, FIFA and SAFF are different sports organisations and were not identified as the supporting organisation for this facility.

mcqs.question: For the FIFA World Cup 2026, where were the opening match and the final scheduled, respectively?
options: Estadio Azteca, Mexico City; MetLife Stadium, USA
MetLife Stadium, USA; Estadio Azteca, Mexico City
Fatorda Stadium, Margao; Estadio Azteca, Mexico City
Estadio Azteca, Mexico City; Fatorda Stadium, Margao
mcqs.explanation: The FIFA World Cup 2026 opening was scheduled at Estadio Azteca in Mexico City, while the final was scheduled at MetLife Stadium in the USA. Fatorda Stadium was associated with the SAFF Women's Championship final, not the FIFA World Cup.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements about the FIFA World Cup 2026 and FIFA:
1. Mexico became the first country to host the FIFA World Cup three times.
2. Argentina entered the FIFA World Cup 2026 as the defending champion.
3. FIFA was established in 1904 in Zurich, and its President was Gianni Infantino.
mcqs.explanation: All three statements are correct: Mexico hosted the World Cup for the third time, Argentina was the defending champion, and FIFA was established in 1904 in Zurich with Gianni Infantino as President. The options omitting one statement incorrectly leave out a fact about the tournament or FIFA.

mcqs.question:
Match the following details relating to the SAFF Women's Championship 2026 and SAFF.

List-I
 a. India's title
 b. Score in the final
 c. Year and place of SAFF's establishment
 d. Number of SAFF members

List-II
 i. Record 6th title
 ii. 3–1
 iii. 1997, Dhaka
 iv. 7

Select the correct code.
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are a-i, b-ii, c-iii and d-iv: India won its record sixth title, defeated Bangladesh 3–1, and SAFF was established in 1997 at Dhaka with seven members. The other codes interchange the title, score, establishment details and membership count.

mcqs.question:
Match the French Open 2026 doubles events with their winners.

List-I
 a. Women's doubles
 b. Mixed doubles
 c. Women's doubles winning pair's first nationality
 d. Mixed doubles winning pair's nationality

List-II
 i. Kateřina Siniaková / Taylor Townsend
 ii. Sara Errani / Andrea Vavassori
 iii. Czechia and USA
 iv. Italy

Select the correct code.
mcqs.explanation: The women's doubles title went to Kateřina Siniaková and Taylor Townsend, while the mixed doubles title went to Sara Errani and Andrea Vavassori. Their listed national associations are Czechia and USA for the women's pair and Italy for the mixed doubles winners.

mcqs.question:
How many of the following statements about Indian performances in the listed June 2026 sporting events are correct?

1. India finished second at the Asian U-20 Athletics event with 19 medals.
2. India won the FIH Women's Nations Cup for the second time and qualified for the FIH Pro League.
3. India defeated Japan 4–1 in the U-18 Hockey Asia Cup, with Ashish Tani Purty scoring a hat-trick.
4. India's women won silver in the U-18 Hockey Asia Cup after defeating South Korea 3–0.
mcqs.explanation: Only statements 1, 2 and 3 are correct, so the answer is Only three. In the U-18 Hockey Asia Cup, India's women won bronze, not silver, despite defeating South Korea 3–0.

mcqs.question:
Match the events and details from the Asian athletics, wrestling and relay championships.

List-I
 a. U-17 Asian Wrestling venue
 b. Number of categories in which Indian women won medals
 c. 2nd Asian Relay Championships venue
 d. Host of the 2027 edition of the Asian Relay Championships

List-II
 i. Da Nang, Vietnam
 ii. 10
 iii. Shaoxing, China
 iv. Chandigarh

Select the correct code.
mcqs.explanation: The correct matching is Da Nang, Vietnam–10 categories–Shaoxing, China–Chandigarh. The U-17 Asian Wrestling event was held at Da Nang, Indian women won medals in all 10 categories, the relay championships were held at Shaoxing, and Chandigarh will host in 2027.

mcqs.question: What was Savitha Shri Bhasker's score when she won the women's Asian Individual Chess Championship 2026?
mcqs.explanation: Savitha Shri Bhasker won the women's Asian Individual Chess Championship 2026 with 7.5/9, on a tie-break. The other figures refer to different sports results: 18 points to Norway Chess, 6:26.09 to rowing, and 19 medals to Asian U-20 Athletics.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): Viswanathan Anand was India's first Grandmaster.
Reason (R): Viswanathan Anand was a five-time world champion.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both the assertion and the reason are true: Anand was India's first Grandmaster and a five-time world champion. His five world titles do not explain why he was India's first Grandmaster, so the second option is correct.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: The SAI–University of Tsukuba sports cooperation MoU was signed for three years.
Statement B: The SAI–University of Tsukuba sports cooperation MoU was signed for four years.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Statement A is correct because the SAI–University of Tsukuba MoU was for three years. Statement B changes the duration to four years, whereas the correct duration was three years.
